description: This file defines classes for generating code snippets for HTTP requests in different programming languages (JavaScript, Python, C#, Java) based on HAR request data, including methods for pretty-printing objects and handling request parameters.

classes.name: JSCodeGen
classes.description: Generates JavaScript code snippets for HTTP requests.

classes.name: PythonCodeGen
classes.description: Generates Python code snippets for HTTP requests.

classes.name: CSharpCodeGen
classes.description: Generates C# code snippets for HTTP requests.

classes.name: JavaCodeGen
classes.description: Generates Java code snippets for HTTP requests.

methods.name: generatePlaywrightRequestCall
methods.description: Creates code for making an HTTP request in the target language based on HAR request data.

methods.name: prettyPrintObject
methods.description: Converts JavaScript objects into language-specific string representations for code generation.

methods.name: stringLiteral
methods.description: Converts a string into a properly escaped string literal for the target language.

methods.name: toFunctionName
methods.description: Converts HTTP method to corresponding C# async function name.

methods.name: getAPIRequestCodeGen
methods.description: Factory function to obtain the appropriate code generator instance based on specified language.
